_doc: Guest tunables (E3-S1, D38 to D43; docs/design.md Guests and reactions has a line for each). Times are simulated seconds, distances yards, click errors fractions of the swing bar (0.05 is 5%, Swing.set_result's units). Read by guests/ from E3-S3 on; tuned by /balance reactions (E3-S8). arrivals_per_day is the count of a day drawn without a rating (scripts and tests); since E4-S5 the game draws 8 + 4 a star, at most 24 (data/economy.json, D58). D46 (E3-S21): day_s is long enough for every group that tees off to finish its nine, and the groups arrive over the first arrival_window_s seconds (seconds, not a share of the day, so the morning rush the pace numbers were tuned on stays the same). skill and patience are drawn evenly between their min and max. Ball work (guest_ticks_per_s) runs while the guest walks and waits; pace counts only time behind a group ahead, at the tee or on the hole (E3-S8 review: its own unfinished putt solve, reading the green, no longer counts), never Ball work. A reaction is given at hole-out or pick-up (guests/guest_reaction.gd, E3-S6). E3-S8 (D44): ready_golf and the queue (GuestBrain.tee_clear) set who plays, and the pace numbers were tuned by /balance reactions. E3-S22 folded E3-S8's tee_clear_yd into play clear (GuestBrain.hold_for): a stroke holds while a guest or ball of a group ahead on its hole lies nearer its cup within play_clear_yd of the ball or inside the landing area (a disc round the planned rest of the larger of play_clear_yd and play_clear_share of the planned distance), or a guest out on another hole, or waiting on another hole's tee (E3-S39), lies within cross_clear_yd of the ball or the rest; after cross_hold_max_s seconds held by other holes alone it plays on. E3-S24: full_sigma_best 0.075 (0.05 before) so skill 10 averages par over the spike holes (scripts/scoring_edges.gd). E3-S20: the club meets the ball at swing_impact_share of stroke_s (the golfer art's impact frame, 4 of 6); a guest sets off to its ball once its flight has been drawn to rest (impact, then the path at flight_draw_speed, watched or not), part way into a second if need be, and strikes no sooner than the second after its walk ends, unless the walk ended within swing_address_share of stroke_s (the address, swing frame 0). flight_draw_speed 7.5 (5 before) keeps D46's day, and wait_base_s 6 (2 before) keeps E3-S8's pace and praise targets (/balance reactions). E3-S54: after E3-S51's putting, play_clear_yd 25 (50 before), cross_clear_yd 15 (20), wait_base_s 8 (6) and wait_per_patience_s 0.8 (1) bring pace across hole shapes back inside its 10 points. E3-S60: day_s 540 (510 before; D46's Update): after E3-S38, E3-S39 and E3-S54 a skill-1 foursome as day 10's second group ended short at 510. E3-S34: putt_tick_weight counts a putt solve's tick 1.5 against frame_ticks_max (the frame budget only, not a second's ticks, so the day is unchanged). E3-S35: a frame serves at most frame_ticks_per_real_s x its length in Ball ticks (200 at 60 fps, 400 at 30), never more than frame_ticks_max (400; 200 before, whatever the frame rate), so a 3x day keeps time at 30 fps as at 60. E3-S37: a group steps onto a tee only while fewer than next_tee_queue_max groups are heading for or standing at the next open hole's tee (0 turns it off), so groups that bunch after a quick hole wait a little on its tee instead of a long while on the slow hole's (GuestBrain.next_tee_free). E4-S3: skip to morning runs the rest of the day over frames; the day is the same as run at any speed. E7-S4: a skip frame runs whole seconds, each served at once with the guests' Ball work on several threads, until skip_frame_ms of real time has gone (at least one second a frame) and at most skip_steps_per_frame seconds (skip_frame_ticks 1,000 and 60 seconds a frame before). E9-S1 (D65): a guest walks walk_yd_per_s over fairway, rough, green, tee and oob, walk_surface_speed times that on each surface (a cart path the quickest, trees, bunkers and water slower), and takes walk_climb_s_per_step more for each height step it climbs between tiles; a walk follows a cart path when that is quicker than the straight line (cart_path_max_detour 1.5, a cap on yards, retired), and pace's walk limit is walk_base_s + walk_per_patience_s x patience seconds (walk_base_yd 60 and walk_per_patience_yd 10 before, the same at the base speed). /balance reactions (E9-S1) set water 0.75 (0.5 put the dogleg's pace fails 0.153 past the fair par 4's, its guests wading across the pond to their balls) and walk_base_s 1.75 (1.5, the old 60 yd, failed the nine's 70 yd walk to hole 8's tee on its one step of climb). E9-S2 (D65): the walk to a tee is its own check, Walk (GuestReaction), judged on walk_base_s + walk_per_patience_s x patience and passed by any walk with at least walk_path_share of its yards on cart path; it weighs walk_check_weight, so a long walk alone is a complaint; pace is the waits alone, and praise_passes is 5 (all five checks).
